answer: Mechanism: Prism-Cluster Diminishing Payout. Payouts are grouped by a prism similarity graph over dune telemetry (request timing, tool-call sequences, payment graph) and juniper challenge nonces. A group’s per-member reward is capped by R/(1+k)^α. Cloning one agent adds k but no verified unique output, so the marginal clone’s expected payout falls below its compute, storage, and challenge-latency costs; only independent behavior raises the cap.
